contents.text: How well must the RX coupling be aligned?

The permissible misalignment for RX couplings up to size 90 is 0.05 mm for parallel offset, 0.05 mm per 100 mm for angular misalignment, and 3 mm ± 0.5 mm for axial gap. For couplings above size 90, the permissible misalignment is halved compared to the values for couplings up to size 90.

RX flexible coupling: installation and alignment
# RX flexible coupling: installation and alignment
Align the shafts with a dial indicator or a laser alignment tool after the gearbox and the motor are bolted down.
Permissible misalignment for RX couplings up to size 90:
| Misalignment | Limit |
|---|---|
| Parallel offset | 0.05 mm |
| Angular | 0.05 mm per 100 mm |
| Axial gap | 3 mm ± 0.5 mm |
Re-check the alignment after the first 100 hours of operation, because the foundation settles.
RX coupling sizes
|---|---|---|---|
| 50 | 50 mm | 450 N·m | PN-5120-A |
| 70 | 70 mm | 1,250 N·m | PN-5170-A |
| 90 | 90 mm | 2,800 N·m | PN-5190-A |
| 110 | 110 mm | 5,200 N·m | PN-5210-A |
For couplings above size 90, halve the permissible misalignment in the table above.

HG-400 Helical Gearbox Operating Manual › 3 Installation › 3.2 Mounting
## 3.2 Mounting
Mount the HG-400 on a flat, rigid base; the mounting surface must be flat to within 0.1 mm.
Use the four M16 foot bolts of property class 8.8 and tighten them to 195 N·m in a cross pattern.
After mounting, align the input and output couplings as their installation instructions describe, and check that the breather plug on top of the housing is fitted and open.

CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual › 5 Commissioning › 5.1 Checks before the first start
# 5 Commissioning
## 5.1 Checks before the first start
2. Check the coupling alignment and fit the coupling guard.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 3 Mechanical problems › Troubleshooting: excessive vibration
# 3 Mechanical problems
Vibration above 4.5 mm/s RMS on the bearing housing needs investigation; above 7.1 mm/s RMS, stop the pump.
Check the coupling alignment.
- Worn bearings.
